## Data

In this report we'll prepare Gapminder plot for year `r params$year`

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)   # ggplot2 + dplyr
library(gapminder)
library(scales)      # alpha()

paramyear <- as.integer(params$year)

data <- gapminder |>
  filter(year == paramyear) |>
  arrange(desc(pop)) |>
  head(10)

knitr::kable(data, caption="Top 10 counties by Population in given year",align="c")
```

## Plot


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Gapminder.org continent colors; Oceania shares Asia's pink
pal <- c(Africa   = "#00D5E8",
         Americas = "#7FE521",
         Asia     = "#FF5872",
         Europe   = "#FFE700",
         Oceania  = "#FF5872")

darken <- function(x, f = 0.75) {           # darker bubble rims
  m <- col2rgb(x) / 255
  setNames(rgb(m[1, ] * f, m[2, ] * f, m[3, ] * f), names(x))
}

gapminder |>
  filter(year == paramyear) |>
  arrange(desc(pop)) |>                     # big bubbles first, small on top
  ggplot(aes(gdpPercap, lifeExp)) +
  annotate("text", x = 6000, y = 49, label = params$year ,          # watermark
           size = 112, colour = "#C7CFD4") +
  annotate("text", x = c(1290, 4400, 13100, 41000), y = 96.4, # level strip
           label = c("INCOME LEVEL 1", "LEVEL 2", "LEVEL 3", "LEVEL 4"),
           size = 2.9, colour = "grey58") +
  annotate("point", x = c(2600, 7800, 23400), y = 96.4,
           shape = 18, size = 1.4, colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = 280, y = 96, label = "years",
           angle = 90, size = 2.6, colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 94000, y = 10.7, hjust = 1, size = 2.9,
           colour = "grey45",
         label = "per person (GDP/capita, PPP$ inflation-adjusted)") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = continent, colour = continent, size = pop),
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits = c(275, 150000), expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = c(500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 32000, 64000, 128000),
    labels = c("500", "1000", "2000", "4000", "8000",
               "16k", "32k", "64k", "128k")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(8.4, 98), expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(10, 90, 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(pal, 0.8)) +   # translucent fill
  scale_colour_manual(values = darken(pal)) +     # opaque darker rim
  scale_size(range = c(1, 34), guide = "none") +  # China ≈ 34 mm wide
  labs(x = "Income", y = "Life expectancy") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    text              = element_text(colour = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    axis.text         = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 12),
    axis.title        = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = 14),
    legend.position   = "none",
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(40, 8, 18, 42)
  )
```
